title: Ceigall India Ltd - 544223 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Ceigall H1 standalone revenue +16.9% and margin 13.4%, but consolidated operating cash flow negative and HAM payments only 40% from NHAI; order book INR22,681 crore, with INR6,000 crore inflow guidance reiterated and EBITDA margin guidance unchanged, not raised.

summary.headline: Ceigall Q2 FY27 standalone revenue rose 23.8% YoY to INR974.5 crore and EBITDA margin reached 13.4%, with order book at INR22,681 crore.
summary.overview: Standalone revenue for Q2 FY27 grew 23.8% YoY to INR974.5 crore, with standalone EBITDA up 42.3% to INR130.5 crore and margin expanding to 13.4% from 11.7%. Consolidated revenue rose 26.8% to INR1,022.5 crore and consolidated PAT rose 64.1% to INR92.2 crore. Management added a 765/400 kV transmission LoI (INR5,700 crore incl. GST) and a five-package NH 913 Arunachal award (INR3,128 crore) during the quarter. Consolidated operating cash flow stayed negative in H1, which management attributed to HAM payment timing.

financial_highlights.change: +42.3% YoY vs INR91.8 crore; margin from 11.7%
+53.2% YoY vs INR113.6 crore; margin from 14.1%

segments.name: Roads and highways
segments.commentary: About 55% of the INR22,681 crore order book. Appointed dates received for Varanasi-Ranchi-Kolkata HAM packages 11 and 12 and Indore-Ujjain greenfield HAM (INR4,050 crore total).

segments.name: Transmission and distribution
segments.commentary: About 21% of order book. Lakadia-Jam Khambhaliya-Jamnagar LoI from REC Power Development (approx. INR5,700 crore incl. GST; 765 kV and 400 kV substations, ~300 km lines, 36-month build, 35-year O&M).

segments.name: Renewable energy
segments.commentary: About 16% of order book. 10 MW of the 147 MW Maharashtra solar plant commissioned ahead of schedule; management cited about INR143 crore renewable turnover this year, with none last year.

segments.name: Metro and industrial infrastructure
segments.commentary: Metro about 4% and industrial infrastructure about 3% of order book.

guidance_outlook: Revenue growth guidance is minimum 15%; management said it expects to overachieve.
EBITDA margin guidance unchanged; management said it will try to overachieve.
FY27 order inflow target INR6,000 crore; about INR5,400 crore already achieved and tenders above INR10,000 crore quoted.

Monetisation of Bathinda-Dabwali and Jalbehra-Shahbad expected to bring about INR250 crore inflow and reduce about INR540 crore of debt; Bathinda-Dabwali targeted this quarter, Jalbehra-Shahbad next quarter, both before March 31.
Equity requirement INR2,632 crore for the asset portfolio; about INR707 crore to be infused in FY27 (after INR161 crore in H1), about INR730 crore in FY28 and INR397 crore in FY29.
Lakadia transmission project work targeted to start before March 31, 2027, which management called a little aggressive.
capex_capacity: Solar: 10 MW commissioned of 147 MW Maharashtra plant, ahead of schedule; solar and BESS execution to scale.
MP Morena solar/BESS: KUSUM solar already started; Morena project still needs PPA, transmission line completion and contractor appointment, so management said start this year looks tough.
HAM monetisation: first HAM asset monetised; Jalbehra-Shahbad provisional COD achieved in the quarter; Delhi-Saharanpur completion certificate received after quarter end.
Equity funding: about INR450 crore expected from Neo Asset Management; SEBI requires promoter holding reduction from 82.06% to 75%.
demand_pricing: Order book INR22,681 crore at 30 Sep 2026 (18 EPC, 10 HAM, 1 DBFOT, 10 tariff-based projects); management cited book-to-bill of about 4.8x.
Management said it bids only where project IRR is at least 25% or EPC EBITDA about 13-14%.
Order book is about 73% developer/HAM-type exposure per management's split; roads about 56%, T&D and solar about 36%.
Northeast push: five NH 913 Frontier Highway packages in Arunachal Pradesh (JV) worth INR3,128 crore, about 278 km.

qa_highlights.question: Given 27% consolidated growth and 13.4% margins, will guidance be revised?
qa_highlights.answer: Management kept revenue growth guidance at minimum 15% and EBITDA margin guidance unchanged, saying it prefers to be conservative and overachieve; growth is being driven by renewables and T&D.

qa_highlights.question: When will the Morena (MP) solar and BESS project start?
qa_highlights.answer: KUSUM solar has started; Morena still needs a PPA, the transmission line is being completed and a contractor is being finalised, so start this year looks tough.

qa_highlights.question: What monetisation inflow and timing for Bathinda-Dabwali and Jalbehra-Shahbad?
qa_highlights.answer: Inflow around INR250 crore with about INR540 crore debt reduction; Bathinda-Dabwali targeted this quarter and Jalbehra-Shahbad next quarter, both before March 31.

qa_highlights.question: Total equity need and funding schedule?
qa_highlights.answer: Requirement INR2,632 crore; INR669 crore infused earlier plus INR161 crore in FY27 leaves about INR1,801 crore. CFO said FY27 balance about INR707 crore, FY28 about INR730 crore, FY29 about INR397 crore, funded by cash surplus, Neo Asset Management (~INR450 crore) and accruals.

qa_highlights.question: Expected execution milestones for the three HAM projects?
qa_highlights.answer: Financial closes for highway projects are done; mobilisation done early; VRK 11 and 12 receiving monthly running bill payments; Indore payment expected before Diwali; execution to pick up especially in March.

qa_highlights.question: Why was H1 consolidated operating cash flow negative despite profit growth?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO attributed it to HAM projects, where only about 40% of payment is received from NHAI, and to the half-year timing; he expects the full-year picture to differ.

qa_highlights.question: What is the FY27 order inflow target and H2 ordering expectation?
qa_highlights.answer: Target INR6,000 crore; about INR5,400 crore achieved and tenders above INR10,000 crore quoted; management said the target is easily achievable.

risks_watch: Consolidated operating cash flow negative in H1 because only ~40% of HAM payments received from NHAI; watch conversion in H2.
Equity requirement of about INR1,962 crore across the asset portfolio (INR707 crore in FY27) and SEBI-mandated promoter holding reduction from 82.06% to 75%.
Lakadia (INR5,700 crore) work-start target before March 31 described by management as aggressive; Morena solar/BESS start delayed by PPA and transmission line.
Consolidated debt about INR1,730 crore versus standalone about INR436 crore; the consolidated debt-to-equity figure was stated as 0.8% (likely 0.8x).
summary.management_tone: Confident and promotional on growth, order inflow and execution, with repeated claims of over-achievement; answers on cash flow and funding were brief, and several questions (for example Morena timing) were answered with hedged timelines.
key_quotes: Here also, this year, we have guided our investors that we will have minimum 15%, and of course, we have overachieved it.
We will always want to be a little conservative on this, and it is always better for the investor to see these surprises.
This is basically because of the HAM project. If you look at the consolidated cash flow, we are only getting 40% payment from the NHAI.

adds.what: 10 MW of 147 MW Maharashtra solar plant commissioned ahead of schedule
MP Morena solar/BESS project (start this year looks tough; needs PPA, transmission line, contractor)

growth.why: Management guides minimum 15% FY27 revenue growth, backed by a INR22,681 crore order book (book-to-bill about 4.8x), with H1 standalone revenue up 16.9% YoY, and EBITDA margin guidance of 11-12.5% held.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Standalone EBITDA margin rose to 13.4% in Q2 from 11.7%, above the unchanged FY27 guidance of 11-12.5%, and management says it will try to overachieve, but H1 consolidated cash conversion was weak and mix shifts toward lower-margin HAM work.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Only 10 MW of the 147 MW Maharashtra solar plant is commissioned, Morena solar/BESS start is slipping (needs PPA, transmission line, contractor), and Lakadia transmission work is targeted before March 31, 2027, which management called a little aggressive.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Management guides minimum 15% FY27 revenue growth against H1 standalone revenue up 16.9% YoY, backed by a INR22,681 crore order book (book-to-bill about 4.8x), and consolidated revenue grew 26.8% in Q2.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Equity needs of about INR707 crore in FY27 and about INR730 crore in FY28 for the HAM portfolio, funded by monetisation and a Neo Asset Management deal of about INR450 crore, point to capital deployment rather than a new capacity capex; utilisation was not disclosed.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Revenue growth guidance is a minimum 15% against 23.8% standalone and 26.8% consolidated Q2 growth, and management said it expects to overachieve, but guidance was held unchanged this quarter.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: H1 standalone revenue grew 16.9% against a 15% floor, EBITDA margin of 13.4% sits above the 11-12.5% guidance, and the order book covers about 4.8x book-to-bill, though H1 consolidated operating cash flow was negative and the Lakadia start is aggressive.

rows.label: FY27 order inflow target INR6,000 crore
rows.why: About INR5,400 crore already achieved with tenders above INR10,000 crore quoted, and management called the target easily achievable.

rows.label: HAM monetisation of Bathinda-Dabwali and Jalbehra-Shahbad
rows.why: About INR250 crore inflow and about INR540 crore debt reduction, with Bathinda-Dabwali targeted this quarter and Jalbehra-Shahbad next quarter, both before March 31.

rows.label: HAM cash conversion in H2
rows.why: H1 consolidated operating cash flow was negative because only about 40% of HAM payments were received from NHAI, and consolidated debt is about INR1,730 crore versus standalone about INR436 crore.

tone.note: Management was confident on growth, order inflow (INR5,400 crore of INR6,000 crore target) and over-achievement, but cautious on Morena solar timing and vague on H1 negative operating cash flow; analysts pushed on guidance revision given 27% growth, cash flow and funding needs.
